[.tooling/iac/terraform/deployments/aws/_policies/README.md#policy-architecture]

## Policy Architecture

These JSON policy templates support dynamic value replacement through terragrunt and terraform processing:

- **Static Replacements** (handled in Terragrunt): Account IDs, environment-specific values
- **Dynamic Replacements** (handled in Terraform): Resource ARNs, cross-resource references
page_texts.3:
[.tooling/iac/terraform/deployments/aws/_policies/README.md#replacement-patterns]

### Replacement Patterns

| Placeholder                            | Replacement Layer | Description                                   |
| -------------------------------------- | ----------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `[[account_number]]`                   | Terragrunt        | AWS Account ID using `get_aws_account_id()`   |
| `[[namespace]]`                        | Terragrunt        | Kubernetes namespace for IRSA                 |
| `[[service_account]]`                  | Terragrunt        | Kubernetes service account for IRSA           |
| `[[opensearch_domain_arn]]`            | Terraform         | OpenSearch domain ARN from resource reference |
| `[[assume_role_policy_resource_name]]` | Terraform         | OIDC provider URL from resource reference     |

[.tooling/iac/terraform/deployments/aws/_policies/README.md#rag-architecture-policies]

## RAG Architecture Policies

| Policy                                                    | Description                                                                             | Replacement Pattern                                                           |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Bedrock Access Policy](bedrock-access-policy.json)       | Grants access to Amazon Bedrock foundation models for RAG LLM and embedding operations. | Static JSON (no replacements)                                                 |
| [IRSA Assume Role Policy](irsa-assume-role-policy.json)   | Trust policy for EKS IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) authentication.              | `[[account_number]]`, `[[namespace]]`, `[[service_account]]` → Dynamic values |
| [OpenSearch Access Policy](opensearch-access-policy.json) | Grants comprehensive access to OpenSearch domain for RAG search operations.             | `[[opensearch_domain_arn]]` → Domain ARN                                      |

> **Note**: CloudWatch logs policy is now provided by the platform via dependency reference (`dependency.platform.outputs.remote_tfstates.account.outputs.cloudwatch_iam_policy_arn`) instead of a separate JSON file.
